question: Q-W-S2-D1
text: For the 2015 month with the largest gap between ordered quantity and units sold, break ordered quantity down by stock item.
interpretation: The 2015 month with the largest absolute gap |ordered quantity - units sold| (order_date vs invoice_date months); ordered quantity by stock item in that month (ties broken by item id).
assemble: WITH g AS (SELECT month_start_date, ordered_quantity, units_sold FROM gap WHERE ordered_quantity IS NOT NULL AND units_sold IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ABS(ordered_quantity - units_sold) DESC, month_start_date LIMIT 1) SELECT g.month_start_date, g.ordered_quantity AS month_ordered_quantity, g.units_sold AS month_units_sold, i.wwi_stock_item_id, i.stock_item, i.ordered_quantity FROM items i JOIN g ON g.month_start_date = i.month_start_date WHERE i.order_lines > 0 ORDER BY i.ordered_quantity DESC, i.wwi_stock_item_id
